tool.name: Biomni: Simulate Cell Population
tool.command:
python -c " import sys import json from biomni.tool.immunology import simulate_cell_population
# Parse arguments args = {} i = 1 while i < len(sys.argv): if sys.argv[i].startswith('--'): key = sys.argv[i][2:] if i + 1 < len(sys.argv) and not sys.argv[i + 1].startswith('--'): val = sys.argv[i + 1] # Type conversion if val.lower() == 'true': val = True elif val.lower() == 'false': val = False else: try: val = int(val) except: try: val = float(val) except: pass args[key] = val i += 2 else: args[key] = True i += 1 else: i += 1
# Call function result = simulate_cell_population(**args)
# Write output output_path = args.get('output', '/dev/stdout') with open(output_path, 'w') as f: if isinstance(result, str): f.write(result) elif isinstance(result, (dict, list)): json.dump(result, f, indent=2, default=str) else: f.write(str(result)) " --output '$output' --time_points '$time_points' --g1_duration '$g1_duration' --s_duration '$s_duration' --g2m_duration '$g2m_duration' --death_rate '$death_rate'
